text:
maya: FYI after the q4b quant bring-up the long-summary route shows a quality dip on longctx. EM ~5.9% down on golden1k, hallucination signal up. digging in.

jon: ouch. any quick repros? can we rule out prompt/template issues? :thinking:

maya: tiny repro pasted below (short snippet). failures all appear >2k tokens. shortctx unaffected.

li: sounds like kv-cache or attention quant mismatch. can we capture cache traces + logits for some ids?

maya: yes. i queued a sampling pull: `samplebank query --filters "route:long-summary,model:q4b,delta>0.03" --limit 500 > /tmp/q4b-long-fails.json`

jon: plan: 1) eng triage to rule out infra/config (next 3h). 2) create micro-golden (200) prioritized by delta/halluc signal. 3) relabel and run logit diffs + kv-diff.

sara: i can allocate labelers tomorrow AM. will create labelflow task with clear instructions + 3+3 examples. who should be assigned? rachel + alice ok?

maya: yes assign rachel + alice. tag schema: hallucination, hallucination_type (fabrication|misinfer), context_miss, trigger_hint. include a free-text note field.

ops-bot: deploy-bot reported: canary quant4b-v2 auto-rollback at 2023-10-12T14:05Z on route "generation-longctx" due to 5% quality regression.

rachel: labeling instruction suggestion: show baseline vs quant outputs, ask labeler to pick exact error span if hallucination. keep examples short and unambiguous.

alice: will do. sara add 3 positive/3 negative examples in the task. link when ready.

jon: i'll capture kv-cache diffs: `kv-diff --ids g-3312,g-3341 --base baseline --new q4b --out /tmp/kv_diffs` and upload traces. also will run `compare_logits.py --ids g-3312,g-3341 --models baseline,q4b --out /tmp/logit_diffs` to find token positions where mass shifts.

li: once we have relabel results, we should run an ablation: reproduce with prefix caching off vs on. caching interaction with quant kernels is suspicious.

maya: timeline: eng triage 3h, labelflow task by EOD, relabel finished by tomorrow noon, then kv/logit analysis. i'll open a short incident ticket linking artifacts.

sara: created task: https://labelflow/tasks/4120 1 micro-golden 200 prioritized by delta and halluc tag, instructions + examples included.

alice: started labeling now. will ping when done.

jon: if relabel confirms real regression, we can try: a) tweak quant rounding params, b) fallback to alternate kernel for attention, or c) revert kernel selection for longctx route.

maya: adding a note for support: customers using long-summary route may see degraded outputs in canary. i will update if we need CS outreach.

deploy-bot: perf-checker: latency steady, mem usage down slightly. regression isolated to quality metrics.

li: copied. once labeled set done i'll run eval harness against holdout to estimate customer impact.

maya: thanks all. i'll post a short follow-up with labeled micro-golden and kv/logit diffs attached. :thumbsup:
